_note: Correction of the 30 October verdict on lindell-wins-minnesota-landslide after reading every Lindell passage, not only the five in the thread.

evidence.summary: Lisa Demuth won the Republican primary for Minnesota governor on 11 August 2026, about 43.4 percent to Lindell's 32.5 percent; Demuth faces Amy Klobuchar on 3 November. On his 12 August stream he read the returns himself (Lindell about 30 percent, Demuth ahead by over 10,000) and said Lindell lost.
evidence.rationale: Scored on what he stated, not on the label. The word landslide only ever appears in prayer (16 April, 7 August), and a prayer is not a prediction. The scoreable line is 1 April 2026 (OVKr-hVqdI4 at 37s): he believes with all his heart Lindell is going to win, given as his own belief after the Lord told him to pray for Lindell. On 16 July he added that the Lord had picked Lindell (LlRONx0fV0A at 2684s). Lindell lost the nomination, so the stated belief failed and cannot recover. Note the walk-back: on 12 August (__45FoTY6rQ at 0s) he said he had never seen Lindell winning, only been told to pray for him, which contradicts his 1 April words. On 24 July he had already said Lindell needed a miracle. Base rate: Minnesota has not elected a Republican statewide since 2006.
